claims: An idle cache entry turns the preview into "unavailable" (src/app/cdps/[symbol]/troves/[troveId]/_lib/trove-og-data.ts:274): unstable_cache serves the stale entry, the age check runs on it, and an entry older than 5 minutes makes the request return null, so a trove preview idle for 5 minutes breaks on its next share
The tests miss the stale-cache bug because the `unstable_cache` mock calls straight through and never serves an old entry

A trove that doesn't exist is labelled as a temporary outage (trove-og-data.ts:203 and :212, shown at _og/trove-og-card.tsx:397 and opengraph-image.tsx:45): symbol not found, trove row not found, validation failure and Hasura error all return the same null, so the card says "temporarily unavailable"

Compact amounts can show "1000K" instead of "1M" (trove-og-data.ts:121-133, compactNumber): the unit is picked from the unrounded value and then toFixed(2) rounds, e.g. 999_995 → "1000K", 999_999_999 → "1000M", 999.996 → "1,000.00"
page.tsx:49: `shortTroveId` duplicates the exported one in `_og/trove-og-card.tsx`; the copies can drift and the page title and card ID must stay identical
`decodeParam` is defined twice (trove-og-data.ts, opengraph-image.tsx) and page.tsx has a third copy as `decodeTroveIdParam`; the copies can drift apart
trove-og-data.ts:184: the `/** @internal Exported for focused data-contract tests. */` comment sits on `fetchTroveOgData`, which isn't exported anymore
src/lib/site-metadata.ts prefers `x-forwarded-host` over `host`; if hosted elsewhere without a proxy that overwrites it, a request could choose the `og:image` origin

judge_reasoning.3882085361: Review's minor note says site-metadata prefers x-forwarded-host, so a request could choose the og:image origin when no overwriting proxy is present. That is the same untrusted-host issue.
judge_reasoning.3882086206: Review flags duplicated shortTroveId and decodeParam, not the icrTone/icrTextClass threshold duplication.
judge_reasoning.3882090788: IPv6 loopback handling is not mentioned.
judge_reasoning.3882119274: Review never raises event-time ICR being presented as a fresh or live health signal.
judge_reasoning.3882119284: Review's cache issue is the opposite problem: stale entries past 5 minutes return null. It does not say that data plus image cache can together serve roughly 11-minute-old content.

1.why: trove-og-data.ts:254-274 caches the result with unstable_cache (revalidate 60, which serves stale while revalidating in the background), then applies troveOgDataIsFresh (5 min) to that cached value. If an entry has sat idle for more than 5 minutes, that request returns null and the card shows 'unavailable'.

2.why: The unstable_cache mock at _lib/__tests__/trove-og-data.test.ts:13-23 just returns fn, so the tests never serve an old cached entry to the freshness check.

3.why: fetchTroveOgData returns the same null for an unknown symbol (:203), a missing trove row (:212), a failed validation (:164) and a thrown error (fetchTroveOgDataForMetadata catch). The card then always shows 'The indexed snapshot is temporarily unavailable.' (trove-og-card.tsx:397).

4.why: I ran compactNumber's exact code in node: 999995 gives '1000K', 999999999 gives '1000M', 999.996 gives '1,000.00', because the unit is chosen before toFixed rounds.

5.why: The diff adds a private shortTroveId to page.tsx:48-50 that is identical to the exported shortTroveId in _og/trove-og-card.tsx:115. The social title and the card/alt ID both depend on it, so the two copies can drift.

6.why: The diff adds identical decodeParam copies in trove-og-data.ts:51 and opengraph-image.tsx:21, next to the existing decodeTroveIdParam in page.tsx:8. All three are used to build the same route identity.

7.why: trove-og-data.ts:184-185 puts the '@internal Exported for focused data-contract tests' comment on 'async function fetchTroveOgData', which is not exported. Only fetchTroveOgDataUncached is.

8.why: Same issue as the known site-metadata.ts:33 defect: resolveMetadataBase trusts x-forwarded-host/host with no allowlist.
